query.esql:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL amount = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL m = DATE_TRUNC(1 month, ts), cur_m = DATE_TRUNC(1 month, NOW())
| WHERE m == cur_m - 1 month OR m == cur_m - 2 month
| EVAL later = CASE(m == cur_m - 1 month, amount, 0.0),
       earlier = CASE(m == cur_m - 2 month, amount, 0.0)
| STATS later_sum = SUM(later), earlier_sum = SUM(earlier)
| EVAL change = later_sum - earlier_sum
| EVAL pct = CASE(earlier_sum > 0, change / earlier_sum * 100, null)
| EVAL `Monthly change` = change,
       `Percent change` = CASE(pct IS NULL, "No earlier month",
                               pct >= 0, CONCAT("▲ ", TO_STRING(ROUND(pct, 1)), "%"),
                               CONCAT("▼ ", TO_STRING(ROUND(ABS(pct), 1)), "%"))
| KEEP `Monthly change`, `Percent change`

FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup

query.esql:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL Deployment = CASE(deployment_name == "", deployment_id, deployment_name)
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| STATS units = SUM(total_chargeable_units) BY ck, ts, Deployment
| LOOKUP JOIN billing_realized_pool_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL score = CASE(heap_used_pct_p95 IS NULL, null,
                    (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight))
| EVAL billed = units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate,
       pool_amount = data_tier_capacity_ecu * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL reclaim = CASE(score IS NULL, null, pool_amount * (1 - score)),
       usage_day = CASE(deployment_sum_store_size IS NULL, 0, 1)
| STATS `Billed consumption` = SUM(billed),
        `Capacity pool` = SUM(pool_amount),
        score_avg = AVG(score),
        `Reclaimable` = SUM(reclaim),
        usage_days = SUM(usage_day)
        BY Deployment
| EVAL `Utilization` = score_avg * 100,
       `Usage data` = CASE(usage_days > 0, "Collected", "Not collected")
| SORT `Billed consumption` DESC
| KEEP Deployment, `Billed consumption`, `Capacity pool`, `Utilization`, `Reclaimable`, `Usage data`
| LIMIT 50

FROM cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN billing_realized_pool_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL
| EVAL util_score = (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * util_score * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL share_storage = CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0,
                            tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size * 1.0 / deployment_sum_store_size, 0.0),
       share_query = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0,
                          tier_and_datastream_sum_query_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_query_time, 0.0),
       share_indexing = CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0,
                             tier_and_datastream_sum_indexing_time * 1.0 / deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0.0)
| EVAL storage_amount = share_storage * chargeable_pool,
       query_amount = share_query * chargeable_pool,
       indexing_amount = CASE(tier == "hot/content", share_indexing * chargeable_pool, 0.0)
| STATS Storage = SUM(storage_amount), Search = SUM(query_amount), Indexing = SUM(indexing_amount) BY ts
| RENAME ts AS `@timestamp`
| SORT `@timestamp` ASC
| LIMIT 5000

| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key

       query_amount = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0,
